# Ticket Transitions

Document allowed movement between statuses.

- Backlog → Ready after scope, acceptance criteria, and dependencies are clear.
- Ready → In Progress when an owner starts.
- In Progress → Review when acceptance criteria are met.
- Review → Done when validation is complete.
- Any active state → Blocked when progress depends on an unresolved external issue.
- Blocked → prior active state when the external issue is resolved.
